description: This file defines the EmployeeSkillDecorator class within the OrangeHRM system, which provides additional methods to manipulate EmployeeSkill entities, such as setting related Employee and Skill instances by their identifiers. It employs traits for ORM helpers and references core entities from the HRM domain.

classes.name: EmployeeSkillDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class providing utility methods to associate EmployeeSkill entities with Employee and Skill objects based on identifiers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with an EmployeeSkill instance.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with the EmployeeSkill based on the employee's number.

methods.name: setSkillBySkillId
methods.description: Associates a Skill entity with the EmployeeSkill based on the skill's ID.
